component.name: DP100 Studio
component.summary: Control and monitor the ALIENTEK DP100 power supply

description.p: DP100 Studio drives the ALIENTEK DP100 USB-C bench power supply over USB: watch it live, change its output, program its presets, record what it delivers, and run step sequences.

ul.li: Live voltage, current and power, with lamps for constant voltage, constant current and every protection trip
A graph of up to an hour of measurements at 100 samples a second that never hides a spike
Setpoints that apply as you change them, and an output switch that asks before turning on
The device's nine preset memories, to edit and recall
Recording to CSV, with energy and charge delivered
Sequences of steps such as ramps, waits and waiting for a condition, checked against the supply's limits before they run

description.p: DP100 Studio is not affiliated with or endorsed by ALIENTEK.

screenshot.caption: Live readings and the graph during a voltage sweep

description.p: A new window, built for a desktop, and constant power.

ul.li: The graph fills the window, beside one panel you size by dragging, with the voltage and current on seven-segment readings in the DP100's own colours
Sequences run from the panel, and are edited in place, with steps that reorder by dragging
Constant power: the app holds a power by moving the current limit, as a mode on the main window and as a sequence step
Stepped ramps, which do what the DP100's own scan mode does
Presets, recording and device settings open as dialogs
